review.why: Pulls structured Google News results (headline, source, link, time) for a keyword and time range through an API script.
review.summary: Runs a bundled Python script against the BrowserAct API to extract news for a keyword, a time filter (past hours to past year) and an item limit. It documents the parameters, the status logs to expect during a run that can take minutes, the output fields, a one-retry rule and ten use cases such as PR and competitor monitoring.
strengths: Explicit retry and key handling: ask for the key, retry once
Structured output ready for a daily digest
cautions: Depends on the BrowserAct service and an API key
Runs can take several minutes, and the agent must not mistake logs for a hang
The script is described, not read in this review
